e.en: She uploaded her resume to a popular {jobsite}.
e.zh: 她把简历上传到一个热门招聘网站。

e.en: The guard was a complete {jobsworth} about the tiny bag.
e.zh: 那个保安为一个小包死抠规定，真像个小官僚。

e.en: Nobody likes a {jobsworth} who refuses harmless exceptions.
e.zh: 没人喜欢那种连无害例外都不肯通融的死板人。

e.en: He wore a {jock-strap} during football practice.
e.zh: 他在足球训练时穿了运动护身三角带。

e.en: The coach reminded players to pack a clean {jock-strap}.
e.zh: 教练提醒队员带上一条干净的运动护身带。

e.en: The young {jockette} won her first race.
e.zh: 那位年轻女骑师赢得了自己的第一场比赛。

e.en: Reporters called the star athlete a campus {jockette}.
e.zh: 记者把那位明星运动员称作校园女运动健将。

e.en: His {jockeyship} ended after a serious fall.
e.zh: 一次严重坠马后，他的骑师生涯结束了。

e.en: The trainer praised her calm {jockeyship} under pressure.
e.zh: 训练师称赞她在压力下沉着的骑术。

e.en: His forced {jocosity} made the meeting awkward.
e.zh: 他勉强的打趣让会议气氛变得尴尬。

e.en: There was a note of {jocosity} in her reply.
e.zh: 她的回答里带着一丝诙谐。

e.en: The memoir recalls the {jocundities} of village festivals.
e.zh: 这本回忆录追忆了乡村节日里的种种欢乐。

e.en: Their letters were full of small {jocundities}.
e.zh: 他们的信里充满了各种轻松愉快的小趣事。

e.en: A rare {jocundity} filled the old house.
e.zh: 一种少有的欢乐气氛充满了那座老房子。

e.en: Her natural {jocundity} lifted everyone's spirits.
e.zh: 她天生的愉快性情让大家都振作起来。

jolty.t: 颠簸的；摇晃的；令人震动的

e.en: The old bus gave us a {jolty} ride through the hills.
e.zh: 那辆旧公交带我们在山间一路颠簸。

e.en: His speech had a {jolty} rhythm that kept everyone alert.
e.zh: 他的演讲节奏突兀有力，让大家一直保持注意。

jomo.t: 错失快乐；不凑热闹的满足感

e.en: After deleting the app, she discovered the quiet pleasure of {JOMO}.
e.zh: 删掉那个应用后，她体会到不凑热闹的安静满足。

e.en: He chose {JOMO} over another crowded networking party.
e.zh: 他宁愿享受错失的快乐，也不去参加又一场拥挤的社交聚会。

e.en: By noon, I had {joned} for coffee all morning.
e.zh: 到中午时，我整个上午都特别想喝咖啡。

e.en: He {joned} for the stage after years away from acting.
e.zh: 离开表演多年后，他又强烈渴望回到舞台。

e.en: She {joneses} for spicy noodles whenever it rains.
e.zh: 一下雨她就特别想吃辣面。

e.en: The retired athlete still {joneses} for competition.
e.zh: 那位退役运动员仍然强烈渴望比赛。

e.en: He was {joning} for a cigarette during the long meeting.
e.zh: 漫长会议中，他一直特别想抽根烟。

e.en: Fans were {joning} for new music after years of silence.
e.zh: 沉寂多年后，歌迷们强烈盼着有新歌。

e.en: That was a {jonnock} answer, though it cost him the job.
e.zh: 那是个诚实的回答，虽然让他丢了工作。

e.en: The judge was known for giving every side a {jonnock} hearing.
e.zh: 那位法官以公平听取各方意见而闻名。

jonnop.t: 亲爱的；老朋友般的称呼

e.en: Come here, {jonnop}, and tell me what happened.
e.zh: 过来，老伙计，告诉我发生了什么。

e.en: The old sailor called every young deckhand {jonnop}.
e.zh: 那位老水手把每个年轻甲板工都亲切地叫作老弟。

e.en: She gave the fire a quick {jook} with the poker.
e.zh: 她用火钳快速戳了戳炉火。

e.en: The runner made a sharp {jook} past the defender.
e.zh: 那名跑者猛地变向，绕过了防守队员。

e.en: The judge allowed {joinder} of the two claims.
e.zh: 法官准许将这两项请求合并审理。

e.en: Her lawyer opposed the {joinder} of another defendant.
e.zh: 她的律师反对把另一名被告加入案件。

joined-up.t: 连贯协调的；字母相连的

e.en: We need more {joined-up} planning across departments.
e.zh: 我们需要各部门之间更连贯协调的规划。

e.en: The child has started writing in {joined-up} letters.
e.zh: 那个孩子已经开始写连笔字母了。

e.en: They formed a {joint-stock} company to fund the voyage.
e.zh: 他们成立了一家股份公司来资助这次航行。

e.en: The old {joint-stock} bank served local merchants.
e.zh: 那家老式股份银行服务当地商人。

e.en: The two firms created a {joint-venture} in Shanghai.
e.zh: 两家公司在上海成立了一家合资企业。

e.en: This factory is a {joint-venture} with a Korean partner.
e.zh: 这家工厂是与韩国伙伴合作的合资项目。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {jointbar} under the rail.
e.zh: 机械师更换了铁轨下方磨损的接缝杆。

e.en: A steel {jointbar} held the two sections together.
e.zh: 一根钢制连接条把两段固定在一起。

e.en: The model's limbs moved {jointedly} but smoothly.
e.zh: 这个模型的四肢有关节地移动，但很顺畅。

e.en: The insect's antennae bent {jointedly} near the tip.
e.zh: 昆虫的触角在靠近末端处分节弯曲。

e.en: The puppet's {jointedness} made it easy to pose.
e.zh: 木偶的有关节性让它很容易摆出姿势。

e.en: The drawing emphasized the {jointedness} of the insect legs.
e.zh: 这幅图突出了昆虫腿部的分节状态。

e.en: The craftsman made a {jointless} silver ring.
e.zh: 工匠做了一枚无接缝的银戒指。

e.en: Some worms have a soft, {jointless} body.
e.zh: 有些虫子的身体柔软且没有关节。

jointress.t: 受寡妇产继承权的女子

e.en: The widow was named {jointress} in the settlement.
e.zh: 那名寡妇在财产安排中被指定享有寡妇产权益。

e.en: As {jointress}, she received income from the estate.
e.zh: 作为享有寡妇产权益的女子，她从地产中获得收入。

e.en: Her {jointure} protected her after her husband's death.
e.zh: 她的寡妇产在丈夫去世后保障了她的生活。

e.en: The carpenter smoothed the {jointure} between the boards.
e.zh: 木匠把木板之间的连接处磨平了。

e.en: The {jointured} widow kept a modest household.
e.zh: 那位有寡妇产安排的寡妇维持着一个朴素的家庭。

e.en: A {jointured} estate supported her for many years.
e.zh: 一份设有寡妇产的地产供养了她许多年。

e.en: A {jointureless} widow could face real poverty.
e.zh: 没有寡妇产的寡妇可能会面临真正的贫困。

e.en: The will left her {jointureless} and dependent on relatives.
e.zh: 遗嘱没有给她留下寡妇产，使她只能依靠亲戚。

jointuring.t: 授予寡妇产；设定寡妇产

e.en: The contract included {jointuring} the bride before marriage.
e.zh: 合同包括在婚前为新娘设定寡妇产。

e.en: Lawyers discussed {jointuring} part of the estate to her.
e.zh: 律师们讨论把部分地产作为寡妇产授予她。

e.en: The dry field was dotted with {jointweed}.
e.zh: 干燥的田地里零星长着节节草类植物。

e.en: Botanists collected {jointweed} along the sandy path.
e.zh: 植物学家沿着沙路采集节节草类植物。

e.en: The farmer blamed {jointworm} for the damaged wheat stems.
e.zh: 农民认为受损的麦秆是麦秆瘿蜂幼虫造成的。

e.zh: 一点音乐让沉闷的会议热闹起来。

e.zh: 听到坏消息后，她想让他开心一点。

e.zh: 他整晚都在逗那支失望的队伍开心。

e.zh: 她从开着的窗户里开心地挥手。

e.zh: 老朋友们一边喝茶一边愉快地聊天。

e.zh: 他天生的开朗让大家都放松下来。

e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会无视这么清楚的警告。

e.zh: 他因弄丢票而骂自己是个笨蛋。

e.zh: 别在安全规则上犯傻。

e.zh: 那出老戏把他嘲笑成一个无害的傻瓜。

e.zh: 你这个笨蛋，又把钥匙忘在里面了。

e.zh: 那部喜剧里的仆人被当成傻瓜看待。

e.zh: 马车沿着崎岖的路颠簸前行。

e.zh: 他们漫长的旅程在日出时结束。

e.zh: 那家老旅店用沉重的大杯盛啤酒。

e.zh: 他不喜欢火车上不停的碰撞和拥挤。

e.zh: 晚饭后，舞者们表演了一支欢快的霍塔舞。

e.zh: 她在西班牙停留期间学会了霍塔舞。

e.zh: 他的说法里没有一丁点真话。

e.zh: 她没有表现出丝毫恐惧。

e.zh: 上课前，学生们打开了各自的记事本。

e.zh: 他书桌旁的抽屉里塞满了旧便笺本。

e.zh: 这部小说包含用魁北克法语口语写成的对白。

e.en: Some critics once dismissed {joual} as improper French.
e.zh: 一些评论家曾把魁北克法语口语视为不规范的法语。

e.zh: 警方短暂追逐后抓住了那个偷车兜风的人。

e.zh: 一名少年飙车取乐者撞坏了三辆停着的车。

e.zh: 消息传来后，房间里充满了静静的喜悦。

e.zh: 这首诗写的是春天里的欢乐。

e.zh: 尽管处境艰难，她的信里仍有一种难得的欢快。

e.en: The music gave the scene a sudden {joyancy}.
e.zh: 音乐让这个场景突然有了喜悦的气息。

e.zh: 正午时分，欢庆的钟声响彻村庄。

e.zh: 听到同意后，她仿佛听见心里响起欢庆的钟声。

e.zh: 这个古老拼法joyfull出现在那首赞美诗中。

e.zh: 他那张充满喜悦的脸让大家都笑了。

e.zh: 水手们把那家酒馆叫作娱乐场所。

e.en: For the children, the library became a {joyhouse}.
e.zh: 对孩子们来说，图书馆成了欢乐之家。

e.en: He plugged in a {joypad} before starting the game.
e.zh: 开始游戏前，他插上了一个游戏手柄。

e.en: This racing game works better with a {joypad}.
e.zh: 这款赛车游戏用控制手柄玩起来更顺手。

e.zh: 他声称自己只是在派对上偶尔吸毒取乐。

e.en: The counselor warned that {joypop} can still become addiction.
e.zh: 辅导员警告说，消遣性用药仍可能发展成成瘾。

joypopper.t: 偶尔吸毒者；消遣性用药者

e.zh: 文章把他描述为偶尔吸毒者，而不是毒贩。

e.zh: 消遣性用药者可能低估依赖的风险。

e.zh: 警方把那辆被偷开兜风的货车还给了车主。

e.zh: 他承认自己曾开着那辆偷来的卡车兜风取乐。

e.zh: 她走路步子轻快而有弹性。

e.zh: 好编辑会删掉报刊套话，让报道听起来更像人话。

e.zh: 她喜欢每天晚上睡前写日记。

e.zh: 职员必须在结账前把每笔交易记入分录。

e.zh: 她在漫长航程中把自己的想法写进了日记。

e.zh: 这笔费用已作为办公用品入账。

e.zh: 学者们讨论主体思想如何影响政策。

judaized.t: 已犹太化的；具犹太特征的

e.en: The community had partly {judaized} its rituals.
e.zh: 这个社群已部分犹太化了自己的仪式。

e.en: They lived in a {judaized} quarter of the town.
e.zh: 他们住在城里一个带有犹太特征的街区。

judaizer.t: 犹太化者；劝守犹太律法者

e.en: Paul argued against the {judaizer} in his letters.
e.zh: 保罗在书信中反驳那位劝人守犹太律法者。

e.en: The historian identified him as a {judaizer}.
e.zh: 历史学家认定他是一个主张犹太化的人。

judaizing.t: 使犹太化；按犹太教行事

e.en: The sect was accused of {judaizing} new converts.
e.zh: 该教派被指责让新皈依者犹太化。

e.en: Some rituals showed a {judaizing} tendency.
e.zh: 一些仪式显示出按犹太教方式行事的倾向。

e.en: The old costume was dyed {judas-color}.
e.zh: 那件旧戏服被染成了红黄色。

e.en: Painters once called this shade {judas-color}.
e.zh: 画家们曾把这种色调称为犹大色。

e.en: The curtain had faded to {judas-colour}.
e.zh: 窗帘已经褪成了红黄色。

e.en: She chose {judas-colour} for the historical robe.
e.zh: 她为那件历史长袍选择了犹大色。

e.en: She poured a {jugful} of water into the basin.
e.zh: 她把一壶水倒进盆里。

e.en: A {jugful} of cider waited on the table.
e.zh: 桌上放着一壶苹果酒。

e.en: Some {juggins} left the gate open again.
e.zh: 又有个傻瓜把门敞着了。

e.en: I felt like a {juggins} after paying twice.
e.zh: 付了两次钱后，我觉得自己像个冤大头。

e.en: The crowd admired his {jugglery} with knives.
e.zh: 人群赞叹他玩刀的杂耍。

e.en: The figures hid a little financial {jugglery}.
e.zh: 这些数字掩盖了一些财务上的花招。

e.en: Don't be a {jughead} about basic safety.
e.zh: 别在基本安全问题上犯傻。

e.en: That {jughead} forgot the tickets at home.
e.zh: 那个笨蛋把票忘在家里了。

juglansin.t: 核桃属植物中的化学物质

e.en: Researchers measured {juglansin} in the walnut extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了核桃提取物中的核桃属化学物质。

e.en: The paper links {juglansin} to several plant reactions.
e.zh: 论文把核桃属化学物质与几种植物反应联系起来。

e.en: Black walnut roots release {juglone} into the soil.
e.zh: 黑胡桃的根会把胡桃醌释放到土壤中。

e.en: Some garden plants are sensitive to {juglone}.
e.zh: 有些园艺植物对胡桃醌很敏感。

e.en: The old anatomy text marked the {jugula} carefully.
e.zh: 那本旧解剖书仔细标出了颈部位置。

e.en: A scarf covered the {jugula} in the portrait.
e.zh: 画像中一条围巾遮住了喉部。

e.en: The policy could {jugulate} local trade before winter.
e.zh: 这项政策可能在冬天前扼杀当地贸易。

e.en: The attacker tried to {jugulate} his victim.
e.zh: 袭击者试图勒住受害者的咽喉。

e.en: The reform was {jugulated} by endless committee delays.
e.zh: 改革被委员会无休止的拖延扼杀了。

e.en: Doctors described a {jugulated} wound near the throat.
e.zh: 医生描述了喉部附近的一处勒伤。

e.en: The monopoly was {jugulating} every small competitor.
e.zh: 这家垄断企业正在扼杀每个小竞争者。

e.en: He was accused of {jugulating} the prisoner.
e.zh: 他被指控勒住那名囚犯的喉咙。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {jugulum} before the incision.
e.zh: 外科医生在切开前检查了颈前部。

e.en: The pendant rested just above her {jugulum}.
e.zh: 吊坠正好落在她喉部上方。

e.en: The diagram shows a small {jugum} between the wings.
e.zh: 图中显示翅膀之间有一个小的轭状连接。

e.en: Botanists used {jugum} for a paired ridge.
e.zh: 植物学家用轭状结构来指一条成对的脊。

e.en: Several {jugums} are visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到几个轭状连接。

e.en: The notes compare the {jugums} of related insects.
e.zh: 笔记比较了相关昆虫的几处成对结构。

e.en: The old slang called him a {juicehead}.
e.zh: 按旧时俚语，他会被叫作酒鬼。

e.en: No one trusted the {juicehead} with their money.
e.zh: 没人放心把钱交给那个瘾君子。

e.en: The orange was dry and {juiceless}.
e.zh: 那个橙子又干又没有汁水。

e.en: His report felt {juiceless} despite the scandal.
e.zh: 尽管题材涉及丑闻，他的报道还是显得枯燥乏味。

e.en: The steak sizzled {juicily} on the grill.
e.zh: 牛排在烤架上滋滋作响，汁水丰盈。

e.en: He described the scandal {juicily} at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时他把那桩丑闻讲得绘声绘色。

e.en: She added dried {jujube} to the tea.
e.zh: 她在茶里加了干枣。

e.en: The child chose a red {jujube} candy.
e.zh: 孩子选了一颗红色的枣味软糖。

e.en: He studies {jujutsu} twice a week.
e.zh: 他每周练两次柔术。

e.en: Traditional {jujutsu} emphasizes throws and joint locks.
e.zh: 传统柔术强调摔投和关节技。

judeo-christian.t: 犹太教与基督教的共同传统；犹太-基督教的

e.en: The speech referred to {Judeo-Christian} moral traditions.
e.zh: 演讲提到了犹太教与基督教共有的道德传统。

e.en: Some historians question the idea of a single {Judeo-Christian} heritage.
e.zh: 一些历史学家质疑所谓单一犹太-基督教遗产的说法。

e.en: Contract law includes many {judge-made} rules.
e.zh: 合同法包含许多由法官判例形成的规则。

e.en: The reform aimed to replace {judge-made} principles with clear statutes.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在用明确成文法取代判例形成的原则。

e.en: The essay used a rare {judgematical} distinction between taste and proof.
e.zh: 这篇文章用一种罕见的判断性区分来划分品味与证明。

e.en: His {judgematical} language sounded old-fashioned to modern readers.
e.zh: 他的判断类措辞在现代读者听来显得过时。

e.en: The philosopher described conscience as a {judgmatic} faculty.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把良知描述为一种作出判断的能力。

e.en: Her {judgmatic} tone made the report feel more like a verdict.
e.zh: 她那种判断式语气让报告更像一份裁决。

judgmatical.t: 判断上的；与判断有关的

e.en: The old treatise makes a {judgmatical} claim about human reason.
e.zh: 这本旧论著提出了一个关于人类理性的判断性主张。

e.en: He avoided {judgmatical} wording in the neutral summary.
e.zh: 他在中立摘要中避免使用带判断色彩的措辞。

e.en: The dispute was {judicable} under local law.
e.zh: 根据当地法律，这起争议可以受理裁决。

e.en: Not every moral wrong is {judicable} in court.
e.zh: 并非每一种道德过错都能在法庭上审判。

e.en: The manuscript used {judical} where modern writers say judicial.
e.zh: 这份手稿用了 judical，而现代作者通常写 judicial。

e.en: Several {judical} officers attended the ceremony.
e.zh: 几名司法官员出席了仪式。

e.en: The committee had no {judicative} authority over the case.
e.zh: 该委员会对这个案件没有裁判权。

e.en: A court's {judicative} role is different from a legislature's role.
e.zh: 法院的审判职能不同于立法机关的职能。

e.en: The king appointed a {judicator} for the border dispute.
e.zh: 国王为边境争端任命了一名裁决者。

e.en: In the game, a neutral {judicator} settled rule conflicts.
e.zh: 在比赛中，一名中立裁判解决规则冲突。

e.en: The church maintained its own {judicatory} for internal disputes.
e.zh: 该教会保留自己的审判机构来处理内部争端。

e.en: The new constitution changed the {judicatory} system.
e.zh: 新宪法改变了司法体系。

e.en: The archaic word {judice} appears in a few legal texts.
e.zh: 这个古旧词 judice 出现在少数法律文本中。

e.en: The phrase sub {judice} means the matter is before a court.
e.zh: 短语 sub judice 意思是该事项正在法院审理中。

e.en: The claim was {judiciable} despite its political background.
e.zh: 尽管有政治背景，这项主张仍可由法院审理。

e.en: The judge found no {judiciable} issue in the complaint.
e.zh: 法官认为诉状中没有可审理的问题。

judoist.t: 柔道运动员；练柔道的人

e.en: The young {judoist} trained every morning before school.
e.zh: 这名年轻柔道运动员每天上学前训练。

e.en: As a former {judoist}, she knew how to fall safely.
e.zh: 作为曾经练柔道的人，她知道怎样安全倒地。

e.en: The {judoka} won the final with a clean throw.
e.zh: 这名柔道运动员用一个漂亮的摔投赢得决赛。

e.en: Every serious {judoka} studies balance and timing.
e.zh: 每个认真的柔道家都会研究平衡和时机。

judoman.t: 男子柔道运动员；练柔道的人

e.en: The {judoman} bowed before stepping onto the mat.
e.zh: 这名男子柔道运动员踏上垫子前鞠了一躬。

e.en: An experienced {judoman} can use an opponent's force.
e.zh: 经验丰富的柔道练习者能借用对手的力量。

e.en: The {jug-eared} boy hated school portraits.
e.zh: 那个招风耳男孩讨厌学校拍的肖像照。

e.en: A {jug-eared} cartoon character smiled from the poster.
e.zh: 海报上一个招风耳卡通人物正在微笑。

jug-handled.t: 有壶形把手的；把手突出的

e.en: She chose a {jug-handled} cup from the shelf.
e.zh: 她从架子上选了一个有壶形把手的杯子。

e.en: The old door had a {jug-handled} iron pull.
e.zh: 那扇旧门上有一个突出的壶把形铁拉手。

e.en: The scan showed a fracture in the {jugal} bone.
e.zh: 扫描显示颧骨处有骨折。

e.en: Some reptiles have a prominent {jugal} arch.
e.zh: 有些爬行动物有明显的颧弓。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {jugate} leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物的成对叶片。

e.en: The diagram showed two {jugate} structures joined at the base.
e.zh: 图中显示两个在底部相连的轭状结构。

e.en: The specimen had {jugated} leaflets along the stem.
e.zh: 这个标本的茎上有成对排列的小叶。

e.en: The bones were {jugated} by a narrow bridge of tissue.
e.zh: 这些骨头由一条狭窄组织桥连接在一起。

e.en: The old diner still has a working {juke-box} near the door.
e.zh: 那家老餐馆门口附近还有一台能用的自动点唱机。

e.en: She chose a song on the {juke-box} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，她在投币点唱机上选了一首歌。

e.en: Many students attend {juku} after their regular school day.
e.zh: 许多学生在正常上课结束后还去日本补习学校。

e.en: The article described how {juku} can shape exam preparation in Japan.
e.zh: 那篇文章描述了日本课外补习学校如何影响备考。

jumbie.t: 加勒比民间传说中的鬼魂

e.en: The villagers feared a {jumbie} that haunted the old road.
e.zh: 村民们害怕一个在旧路上出没的加勒比鬼魂。

e.en: Her story used the {jumbie} as a symbol of guilt.
e.zh: 她的故事把那个鬼魂当作罪疚感的象征。

e.en: The desk was a {jumblement} of bills, notes, and keys.
e.zh: 桌上账单、便条和钥匙乱成一团。

e.en: His speech became a {jumblement} of memories and apologies.
e.zh: 他的讲话变成了回忆和道歉混杂的一团。

jumblies.t: 杂乱的小物件；胡言乱语

e.en: She emptied the drawer and sorted the {jumblies} into boxes.
e.zh: 她清空抽屉，把那些杂乱小物件分装进盒子。

e.en: The sleepy child muttered {jumblies} instead of a clear answer.
e.zh: 那个犯困的孩子没有清楚回答，只是含糊地胡言乱语。

e.en: The facts were presented {jumblingly}, so nobody understood the timeline.
e.zh: 事实被杂乱地陈述出来，所以没人弄清时间线。

e.en: He spoke {jumblingly} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后他说话混乱不清。

e.en: Her notes were {jumbly} but full of useful ideas.
e.zh: 她的笔记虽然杂乱，却有很多有用想法。

e.en: The puzzle looked {jumbly} until we found the corner pieces.
e.zh: 在找到角块之前，拼图看起来乱成一团。

e.en: They ordered a {jumbo-sized} pizza for the whole team.
e.zh: 他们给整个团队点了一个特大号披萨。

e.en: The store sells {jumbo-sized} packs of diapers.
e.zh: 这家店出售超大包装的尿布。

e.en: The company tried to {jumboise} its packaging for warehouse shoppers.
e.zh: 公司试图把包装做成超大号，以迎合仓储式购物者。

e.en: Designers should not {jumboise} every button on a mobile screen.
e.zh: 设计师不该把手机屏幕上的每个按钮都放大成超大号。

e.en: The brand is {jumboising} its snack bags for the holiday season.
e.zh: 这个品牌正为节日季把零食袋做成超大号。

e.en: Constantly {jumboising} portions can encourage waste.
e.zh: 不断把份量做大可能会助长浪费。

jumbojet.t: 大型喷气式客机；巨型喷气机

e.en: The {jumbojet} landed smoothly despite the storm.
e.zh: 尽管有暴风雨，那架大型喷气式客机仍平稳降落。

e.en: Tourists boarded the {jumbojet} for a twelve-hour flight.
e.zh: 游客们登上那架巨型喷气机，准备飞行十二小时。

e.en: The old song mentions a {jumbuck} by the billabong.
e.zh: 那首老歌提到水潭边的一只羊。

e.en: A lost {jumbuck} wandered near the dusty track.
e.zh: 一只走失的羊在尘土飞扬的小路旁徘徊。

e.en: Villagers whispered that a {jumby} haunted the old house.
e.zh: 村民们低声说，有个鬼魂在那座老房子里出没。

e.en: The child feared every shadow was a {jumby}.
e.zh: 那个孩子害怕每个影子都是传说中的鬼魂。

e.en: The farmer led the {jument} back to the stable.
e.zh: 农夫把那匹母马牵回马厩。

e.en: In old texts, a {jument} could mean a beast of burden.
e.zh: 在古文中，jument 可以指驮重物的牲畜。

e.en: The {jump-jet} rose straight from the carrier deck.
e.zh: 那架垂直起降喷气机从航母甲板上直升而起。

e.en: Engineers tested a new {jump-jet} in strong crosswinds.
e.zh: 工程师在强侧风中测试一款新的垂直起降喷气机。

e.en: The rider won the {jump-off} by less than a second.
e.zh: 那名骑手以不到一秒的优势赢得了加赛。

e.en: The meeting became a {jump-off} for wider reform.
e.zh: 这次会议成了更大范围改革的起点。

e.en: She bought a new {jump-rope} for exercise.
e.zh: 她买了一根新跳绳来锻炼。

e.en: The children like to {jump-rope} after school.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢放学后跳绳。

e.en: A tiny {jump-spark} flashed between the wires.
e.zh: 电线之间闪过一小道跨隙火花。

e.en: The mechanic checked whether the plug produced a {jump-spark}.
e.zh: 机械师检查火花塞是否产生跳火花。

e.en: Can you {jump-start} my car this morning?
e.zh: 你今天早上能帮我的车搭电启动吗？

e.en: The grant helped {jump-start} the local arts project.
e.zh: 这笔资助帮助当地艺术项目迅速启动。

jump-started.t: 已搭电启动；已推动起来

e.en: A neighbor {jump-started} the dead battery.
e.zh: 一位邻居给没电的电瓶搭电启动了。

e.en: The campaign {jump-started} public interest in cycling.
e.zh: 这场活动迅速激发了公众对骑行的兴趣。

e.en: He is {jump-starting} the truck with long cables.
e.zh: 他正用长电缆给卡车搭电启动。

e.en: The new policy is {jump-starting} investment in housing.
e.zh: 这项新政策正在快速推动住房投资。

e.en: The garage offers free {jump-starts} in winter.
e.zh: 这家修车厂冬天提供免费搭电启动服务。

e.en: Good training {jump-starts} a young employee's career.
e.zh: 良好的培训能迅速开启年轻员工的职业发展。

e.en: The director used a {jumpcut} to show confusion.
e.zh: 导演用一个跳切来表现混乱感。

e.en: That sudden {jumpcut} makes the video feel nervous.
e.zh: 那个突然的跳接镜头让视频显得紧张。

jumped-up.t: 自命不凡的；暴发户式的

e.en: He sounded like a {jumped-up} clerk giving orders.
e.zh: 他说话像个自命不凡的小职员在发号施令。

e.en: They dismissed him as a {jumped-up} newcomer.
e.zh: 他们把他看作一个暴发户式的新来者而不屑一顾。

jumpier.t: 更紧张不安的；更易受惊的

e.en: She felt {jumpier} after drinking two coffees.
e.zh: 喝了两杯咖啡后，她觉得更紧张不安。

e.en: The dog grew {jumpier} as the fireworks got louder.
e.zh: 烟花声越来越响，那只狗变得更容易受惊。

jumpiest.t: 最紧张不安的；最易受惊的

e.en: He was the {jumpiest} person in the room.
e.zh: 他是房间里最紧张不安的人。

e.en: The {jumpiest} horse refused to approach the gate.
e.zh: 那匹最容易受惊的马不肯靠近门口。

e.en: She answered {jumpily} when the phone rang.
e.zh: 电话响起时，她紧张不安地回答。

e.en: The lights flickered {jumpily} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中灯光神经质般地闪烁。

e.en: His {jumpiness} made the interview feel awkward.
e.zh: 他的紧张不安让面试气氛变得尴尬。

e.en: Caffeine can increase {jumpiness} in some people.
e.zh: 咖啡因会让一些人更容易紧张受惊。

e.en: This question is a useful {jumping-off} point for debate.
e.zh: 这个问题是展开辩论的有用出发点。

e.en: The cliff was a dangerous {jumping-off} place.
e.zh: 那处悬崖是个危险的跳下地点。

e.en: The {jumpmaster} checked every parachute before takeoff.
e.zh: 起飞前，跳伞指挥员检查了每个降落伞。

e.en: A calm {jumpmaster} gave the signal to jump.
e.zh: 一位冷静的跳伞指挥员发出了跳伞信号。

e.en: Her {jumpshot} won the game in overtime.
e.zh: 她的跳投在加时赛中赢下了比赛。

e.en: He practiced his {jumpshot} for an hour after class.
e.zh: 下课后他练了一个小时跳投。

juncaceous.t: 灯心草科的；似灯心草的

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {juncaceous} stems near the marsh.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到沼泽旁那株植物有似灯心草的茎。

e.en: A {juncaceous} clump grew where the ground stayed wet.
e.zh: 一丛灯心草科植物长在地面长期潮湿的地方。

e.en: A dark-eyed {junco} hopped across the snowy path.
e.zh: 一只暗眼灯草雀跳过积雪的小路。

e.en: She identified the {junco} by its pale bill.
e.zh: 她凭它浅色的喙认出了那只灯草雀。

e.en: Several {juncoes} gathered beneath the feeder at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，几只灯草雀聚在喂食器下面。

e.en: The children watched the {juncoes} scatter into the shrubs.
e.zh: 孩子们看着那些灯草雀散入灌木丛中。

e.en: The doctor studied the {junctional} rhythm on the heart monitor.
e.zh: 医生查看心电监护仪上的交界性心律。

e.en: Cracks appeared in the {junctional} area between the two walls.
e.zh: 两堵墙的交界部位出现了裂缝。

e.en: The report focused on the {junctural} causes of the crisis.
e.zh: 报告着重分析了这场危机在特定关头形成的原因。

e.en: Her speech captured the {junctural} mood of the country.
e.zh: 她的演讲抓住了国家处在关键时刻的情绪。

e.en: We picked ripe {juneberries} along the edge of the field.
e.zh: 我们在田边采摘成熟的六月莓。

e.en: The baker folded {juneberries} into a simple summer pie.
e.zh: 面包师把六月莓拌进一个简单的夏日派里。

e.en: A {junebug} bumped against the porch light all evening.
e.zh: 一只六月甲虫整晚都撞着门廊灯。

e.en: The child held a shiny {junebug} in a jar.
e.zh: 孩子把一只发亮的金龟子装在罐子里。

e.en: The old travel book described the tribe as {jungli}.
e.zh: 那本旧游记把这个部落描写成野性未驯。

e.en: He used the word {jungli} in a dated colonial tone.
e.zh: 他用“jungli”这个词时带着过时的殖民腔调。

juniorate.t: 初级教士培养阶段或机构

e.en: He entered the {juniorate} before beginning formal theological studies.
e.zh: 他在开始正式神学学习前进入了初级教士培养阶段。

e.en: The order closed its rural {juniorate} after enrollment fell.
e.zh: 由于入学人数下降，该修会关闭了乡村的初级修院。

e.en: Her {juniority} meant she had little influence in meetings.
e.zh: 她资历较浅，所以在会议上影响力不大。

e.en: The contract protected workers regardless of {juniority}.
e.zh: 合同保护工人，不论他们资历深浅。

e.en: The fund bought a risky {junk-bond} issue last quarter.
e.zh: 这只基金上季度买入了一期高风险垃圾债券。

e.en: Analysts warned that the {junk-bond} market looked overheated.
e.zh: 分析师警告说，垃圾债券市场看起来过热。

junketeer.t: 公费游玩者；借考察旅游者

e.en: The columnist mocked every congressional {junketeer} on the trip.
e.zh: 专栏作家嘲讽了这次行程中每个借公差旅游的国会议员。

e.en: He denied being a {junketeer} and published his expense records.
e.zh: 他否认自己是公费游玩者，并公开了开支记录。

e.en: This is the {junkiest} laptop I have ever used.
e.zh: 这是我用过的质量最差的笔记本电脑。

e.en: They sold the {junkiest} furniture at the back of the store.
e.zh: 他们把最破旧的家具放在店后面出售。

e.en: The {junkmen} came early to haul away the old stove.
e.zh: 废品收购商一早就来把旧炉子拖走了。

e.en: Neighborhood {junkmen} searched the alley for scrap metal.
e.zh: 附近的拾荒者在小巷里寻找废金属。

e.en: The museum displayed a silk {jupe} from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件十八世纪的丝质女裙。

e.en: Her costume included a fitted {jupe} over layered petticoats.
e.zh: 她的戏服包括一件贴身短裙，下面叠着衬裙。

e.en: The knight wore a padded {jupon} over his armor.
e.zh: 骑士在盔甲外穿着一件有衬垫的短罩衣。

e.en: A lace {jupon} showed beneath the hem of the dress.
e.zh: 一条蕾丝衬裙从连衣裙下摆露了出来。

e.en: The actor played a {jut-jawed} detective in the old film.
e.zh: 那位演员在老电影里饰演一个下巴突出的侦探。

e.en: His {jut-jawed} profile made him look stubborn.
e.zh: 他凸颌的侧脸让他显得很固执。

e.en: A stone {jutty} overlooked the narrow lane.
e.zh: 一处石头突出部俯瞰着狭窄的小巷。

e.en: The old balcony seemed to {jutty} over the street.
e.zh: 那座旧阳台像是伸到了街道上方。

e.en: Researchers tested {juvabione} on several insect larvae.
e.zh: 研究人员在几种昆虫幼虫身上测试了保幼激素类似物。

e.en: The paper described {juvabione} as a natural insect regulator.
e.zh: 论文把保幼激素类似物描述为一种天然昆虫调节物。

e.en: He was sent to {juve} after the hearing.
e.zh: 听证后，他被送进了少年管教所。

e.en: The coach works with {juve} players from local schools.
e.zh: 这名教练带当地学校的青少年球员训练。

e.en: The myth promised {juvenescence} to anyone who drank the spring water.
e.zh: 这个神话说，喝下泉水的人都能恢复青春。

e.en: Critics saw the reform as a political {juvenescence}.
e.zh: 评论家把这次改革看作政治上的重新焕发活力。

e.en: The spa advertised a {juvenescent} effect on tired skin.
e.zh: 这家水疗馆宣传它能让疲惫的皮肤焕发青春。

e.en: After months of rest, the city felt strangely {juvenescent}.
e.zh: 经过数月休整，这座城市奇异地显得重新年轻起来。

e.en: The diary preserves his early {juvenilities} without embarrassment.
e.zh: 这本日记坦然保留了他早年的幼稚表现。

e.en: She dismissed the jokes as harmless {juvenilities}.
e.zh: 她把那些笑话看作无伤大雅的少年式幼稚。

e.en: His argument had the charm and weakness of {juvenility}.
e.zh: 他的论点既有少年气的魅力，也有幼稚的弱点。

e.en: The plant remains in {juvenility} for several years before flowering.
e.zh: 这种植物在开花前会保持数年的幼年状态。

e.en: The campaign tried to {juvenilize} the brand's image.
e.zh: 这场宣传试图让品牌形象年轻化。

e.en: Critics said the show would {juvenilize} serious debate.
e.zh: 批评者说这个节目会让严肃辩论变得幼稚化。

e.en: The essay imagined a {juvenocracy} run by voters under thirty.
e.zh: 那篇文章设想了一个由三十岁以下选民主导的青年政体。

e.en: Older officials feared the party was drifting toward {juvenocracy}.
e.zh: 年长官员担心该党正滑向青年掌权。

e.en: The poet used {juvenscence} as a symbol of spring.
e.zh: 诗人把青春化用作春天的象征。

e.en: The clinic promised gradual {juvenscence} through its treatment.
e.zh: 这家诊所承诺通过治疗让人逐渐恢复青春。

e.en: The judge warned him that another offense meant {juvie}.
e.zh: 法官警告他，再犯一次就要进少管所。

e.en: She wrote a novel about a {juvie} trying to start over.
e.zh: 她写了一本小说，讲一个少年犯努力重新开始。

e.en: The {juxtaglomerular} cells help regulate blood pressure.
e.zh: 近肾小球细胞有助于调节血压。

e.en: Doctors suspected a {juxtaglomerular} tumor after the tests.
e.zh: 检查后，医生怀疑是近肾小球肿瘤。

e.en: The poem gains force through its {juxtapositional} structure.
e.zh: 这首诗通过并置式结构获得力量。

e.en: Her paintings use {juxtapositional} contrasts of light and decay.
e.zh: 她的画运用光亮与腐朽的并置对比。

e.en: A {jynx} can twist its neck in a startling way.
e.zh: 歪脖鸟能以惊人的方式扭动脖子。

e.en: The field guide listed the {jynx} among small woodpecker relatives.
e.zh: 野外手册把蚁鴷列在小型啄木鸟亲缘鸟类中。

e.en: The old deed named the {jurant} beside the seal.
e.zh: 那份旧契约在印章旁写着宣誓人的名字。

e.en: A {jurant} must swear before the officer.
e.zh: 宣誓者必须在官员面前立誓。

e.en: The affidavit lacked a proper {jurat}.
e.zh: 这份宣誓书缺少合格的宣誓证明。

e.en: She checked the {jurat} before filing the document.
e.zh: 她提交文件前检查了宣誓签注。

e.en: The court required a {juratory} statement from him.
e.zh: 法院要求他提交一份宣誓声明。

e.en: Her {juratory} promise carried legal weight.
e.zh: 她的宣誓承诺具有法律分量。

e.en: Several {jurats} were missing from the affidavits.
e.zh: 几份宣誓书缺少宣誓证明。

e.en: The clerk compared the {jurats} on each page.
e.zh: 书记员核对了每页上的宣誓签注。

e.en: He was king de {jure}, though not in power.
e.zh: 他依法是国王，尽管没有实权。

e.en: The office existed de {jure} but not in practice.
e.zh: 这个职位依法存在，但实际并未运作。

e.en: The market sold fresh {jurel} by the kilo.
e.zh: 市场按公斤出售新鲜鲹鱼。

e.en: Grilled {jurel} is common in coastal kitchens.
e.zh: 烤鲹鱼在沿海厨房里很常见。

e.en: The treaty created a new {juridic} framework.
e.zh: 该条约建立了新的法律框架。

e.en: Their argument focused on {juridic} authority.
e.zh: 他们的论点集中在司法权威上。

e.en: A {jurimetrician} analyzed patterns in sentencing data.
e.zh: 一名计量法学专家分析了量刑数据中的规律。

e.en: The law school hired a {jurimetrician} for the research project.
e.zh: 法学院为这个研究项目聘请了一名计量法学专家。

e.en: The {jurimetricist} built models of court behavior.
e.zh: 这位计量法学研究者建立了法院行为模型。

e.en: As a {jurimetricist}, she studies legal decisions statistically.
e.zh: 作为计量法学研究者，她用统计方法研究法律判决。

e.en: The prince consulted a respected {jurisconsult}.
e.zh: 王子咨询了一位受尊敬的法学家。

e.en: A Roman {jurisconsult} shaped later legal thought.
e.zh: 一位罗马法学家影响了后来的法律思想。

e.en: The agency claimed {jurisdictive} power over the dispute.
e.zh: 该机构声称对这场争议拥有司法管辖权。

e.en: The judge explained the court's {jurisdictive} limits.
e.zh: 法官解释了法院的管辖限制。

e.en: His {jurisprudent} writings influenced constitutional theory.
e.zh: 他的法理学著作影响了宪法理论。

e.en: The old {jurisprudent} advised caution in reform.
e.zh: 这位老法学家建议改革时保持谨慎。

e.en: The company has a separate {juristic} personality.
e.zh: 这家公司具有独立的法律人格。

e.en: Her essay used a strictly {juristic} analysis.
e.zh: 她的文章采用了严格的法学分析。

e.en: The professor preferred a {juristical} explanation.
e.zh: 教授更倾向于法学上的解释。

e.en: This doctrine has a long {juristical} history.
e.zh: 这一学说有很长的法学史。

e.en: The contract is {juristically} valid despite the error.
e.zh: 尽管有错误，这份合同从法律上仍然有效。

e.en: She examined the case {juristically}, not politically.
e.zh: 她从法律角度而非政治角度审视此案。

e.en: The prosecutor accused him of being a {jury-fixer}.
e.zh: 检察官指控他是操纵陪审团的人。

e.en: A notorious {jury-fixer} approached several witnesses.
e.zh: 一名臭名昭著的陪审团操纵者接近了几名证人。

e.en: The sailors raised a {jury-mast} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，水手们竖起了一根临时桅杆。

e.en: A rough {jury-mast} kept the boat moving.
e.zh: 一根简陋的应急桅杆让船继续前行。

e.en: We had to {jury-rig} a charger from spare parts.
e.zh: 我们只好用零件临时拼出一个充电器。

e.en: They will {jury-rig} a shelter before nightfall.
e.zh: 他们会在天黑前临时搭个住处。

jury-rigged.t: 临时拼凑的；凑合搭成的

e.en: The antenna was {jury-rigged} from wire and tape.
e.zh: 天线是用电线和胶带临时拼成的。

e.en: A {jury-rigged} bridge carried them across the stream.
e.zh: 一座临时搭成的桥让他们过了小溪。

e.en: The {juryman} listened carefully to the testimony.
e.zh: 那名陪审员仔细听取了证词。

e.en: A tired {juryman} asked to review the evidence.
e.zh: 一名疲惫的陪审员要求复查证据。

e.en: The {jurymen} returned after two hours.
e.zh: 陪审员们两小时后回来了。

e.en: Several {jurymen} questioned the witness's memory.
e.zh: 几名陪审员质疑证人的记忆。

juryrigged.t: 临时拼凑的；凑合搭成的

e.en: The motor was {juryrigged} to run one more day.
e.zh: 这台电机被临时修到还能再运转一天。

e.en: Their {juryrigged} system failed under heavy use.
e.zh: 他们临时拼凑的系统在高强度使用下失灵了。

e.en: The {jurywoman} took notes throughout the trial.
e.zh: 那名女陪审员在整个庭审中都做了笔记。

e.en: One {jurywoman} asked for a clearer instruction.
e.zh: 一名女陪审员要求给出更清楚的说明。

jurywomen.t: 女陪审员们；女性陪审员

e.en: The judge thanked the {jurywomen} for their careful attention.
e.zh: 法官感谢这些女陪审员认真听审。

e.en: Several {jurywomen} asked to review the evidence again.
e.zh: 几名女性陪审员要求再次查看证据。

e.en: The scholar discussed a {jussive} form in ancient Hebrew.
e.zh: 那位学者讨论了古希伯来语中的祈使命令式形式。

e.en: A {jussive} sentence can express a command or wish.
e.zh: 祈使句可以表达命令或愿望。

e.en: The {just-arrived} guests waited in the lobby.
e.zh: 刚到的客人在大厅里等候。

e.en: She opened the {just-arrived} package at once.
e.zh: 她立刻打开了刚送到的包裹。

e.en: The {just-ended} meeting left everyone tired.
e.zh: 刚结束的会议让大家都很疲惫。

e.en: Fans discussed the {just-ended} season online.
e.zh: 粉丝们在网上讨论刚完结的这一季。

e.en: The policy was judged against a {just-scale} of public benefit.
e.zh: 这项政策按照公共利益的公平标准来评判。

e.en: Philosophers argued over what a {just-scale} should measure.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论公正尺度究竟应衡量什么。

e.en: The report offered no {justfication} for the sudden delay.
e.zh: 报告没有为这次突然延误给出任何正当理由。

e.en: His angry tone needed more {justfication} than he provided.
e.zh: 他的愤怒语气需要比他给出的更多辩解。

e.en: She accepted the {justiceship} after years of public service.
e.zh: 多年公职服务后，她接受了法官职位。

e.en: The vacant {justiceship} drew interest from senior lawyers.
e.zh: 空缺的司法职务引起了资深律师的兴趣。

e.en: The court questioned the {justiciability} of the political dispute.
e.zh: 法院质疑这起政治争议是否具有可审判性。

e.en: Law students studied {justiciability} in constitutional cases.
e.zh: 法学院学生研究宪法案件中的可诉性。

e.en: The king appointed a {justiciar} to govern in his absence.
e.zh: 国王任命一名高等司法官在他离国时治理国家。

e.en: A medieval {justiciar} often held both legal and political power.
e.zh: 中世纪的高等司法官常同时拥有法律和政治权力。

e.en: The reform strengthened the {justiciary} authority of the court.
e.zh: 这项改革加强了法院的司法权威。

e.en: He served as a {justiciary} in the old kingdom.
e.zh: 他在旧王国担任司法官。

e.en: Researchers isolated {justicin} from the plant sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物样本中分离出了正义菌素。

e.en: The paper examined whether {justicin} affected tumor cells.
e.zh: 论文研究了正义菌素是否会影响肿瘤细胞。

e.en: They debated the {justifiability} of using force.
e.zh: 他们辩论使用武力的正当性。

e.en: The decision's {justifiability} depended on the evidence available.
e.zh: 这一决定是否可辩护取决于当时掌握的证据。

e.en: The lawyer submitted a {justificative} document to the court.
e.zh: 律师向法院提交了一份证明性文件。

e.en: His speech had a strongly {justificative} tone.
e.zh: 他的讲话带有很强的辩解意味。

e.en: He became the chief {justifier} of the unpopular policy.
e.zh: 他成了这项不得人心政策的主要辩护者。

e.en: A good editor is not merely a {justifier} of old habits.
e.zh: 优秀编辑不只是旧习惯的辩护者。

e.en: People began to {justle} near the narrow gate.
e.zh: 人们开始在狭窄的门口互相推挤。

e.en: The carts {justle} together on the rough road.
e.zh: 几辆车在崎岖道路上相互碰撞。

e.en: The crowd {justled} him toward the exit.
e.zh: 人群把他推挤到了出口方向。

e.en: Two wagons {justled} noisily in the lane.
e.zh: 两辆马车在小巷里吵闹地碰撞。

e.en: The {justling} passengers filled the station platform.
e.zh: 互相推挤的乘客挤满了车站站台。

e.en: He heard the {justling} of carts outside.
e.zh: 他听见外面车辆碰撞的声音。

e.en: The shop specializes in {jeanswear} for teenagers.
e.zh: 这家店专卖面向青少年的牛仔服饰。

e.en: Her brand mixes luxury tailoring with casual {jeanswear}.
e.zh: 她的品牌把高级剪裁和休闲牛仔装结合起来。

e.en: The caravan rested below a rocky {jebel}.
e.zh: 商队在一座多岩石的山丘下休息。

e.en: On the map, each {jebel} was marked with an Arabic name.
e.zh: 地图上每座山都标着阿拉伯名称。

e.en: The driver shouted {jee} to turn the oxen right.
e.zh: 赶车人喊jee，让牛群向右转。

e.en: In old farming commands, {jee} meant move to the right.
e.zh: 在旧式农事口令中，jee表示向右走。

e.en: The road is barely {jeepable} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后，这条路勉强还能让吉普车通行。

e.en: They searched for a {jeepable} track across the desert.
e.zh: 他们寻找一条吉普车能穿越沙漠的车道。

e.en: {Jeepers}, that thunder was louder than I expected.
e.zh: 天哪，那声雷比我预想的响多了。

e.en: She whispered {jeepers} when the bill arrived.
e.zh: 账单送来时，她低声说了句哎呀。

e.en: We rode a crowded {jeepney} across Manila.
e.zh: 我们坐着拥挤的吉普尼小巴穿过马尼拉。

e.en: The old {jeepney} was painted in bright colors.
e.zh: 那辆旧吉普尼小巴漆着鲜艳的颜色。
